loop_2320.name: Other Subscriber Information
loop_2320.conditional: Required when other payers are known to potentially be involved in paying on this claim. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

sbr01.name: payer_responsibility_sequence_number_code
sbr01.description: Within a claim, values other than U may occur at most once. U is payer-to-payer COB only when sequence is unknown.

sbr03.name: insured_group_or_policy_number
sbr03.conditional: Required when the other payer ID card shows a group number. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

sbr04.name: other_insured_group_name
sbr04.conditional: Required when SBR03 is not used and the group name is available. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

sbr05.name: insurance_type_code
sbr05.conditional: Required when the other payer is Medicare and SBR01 is not P. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

sbr09.name: claim_filing_indicator_code
sbr09.conditional: Required prior to mandated use of the HIPAA National Plan ID. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

CAS.name: Claim Level Adjustments
CAS.conditional: Required when the claim has been adjudicated by this other payer and has claim-level adjustment information. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

cas01.name: claim_adjustment_group_code
cas01.description: CO=Contractual Obligations, CR=Correction and Reversals, OA=Other adjustments, PI=Payor Initiated Reductions, PR=Patient Responsibility

cas04.name: adjustment_quantity_1

cas05.name: adjustment_reason_code
cas05.conditional: Required when it is necessary to report an additional non-zero adjustment. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

cas07.name: adjustment_quantity
cas07.conditional: Required when the related reason code is present and is related to a units of service adjustment. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

oi04.name: patient_signature_source_code
oi04.conditional: Required when a signature was executed on the patient’s behalf under state or federal law. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

MOA.name: Outpatient Adjudication Information
MOA.conditional: Required when outpatient adjudication information is reported in the remittance advice OR when it is necessary to report remark codes. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

validation_rules.rule: SBR01/02 required; SBR06-08 not used; SBR09 situational; SBR02=01|18|19|20|21|39|40|53|G8
SBR01 values other than U may occur at most once per claim
CAS max 5; CAS01-03 required when CAS used; CAS08-19 trios situational
AMT D/A8/EAF situational; AMT03 not used
OI required when 2320 used; OI01/02/05 not used

nm104.name: other_subscriber_first_name
nm104.conditional: Required when NM102=1 and the person has a first name. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

nm108.name: identification_code_qualifier
nm108.description: II=HIPAA Individual Identifier when mandated, otherwise MI=Member ID

N3.name: Other Subscriber Address
N3.conditional: Required when the information is available. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n302.name: address_line_2
n302.conditional: Required when there is a second address line. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

N4.name: Other Subscriber City, State, ZIP Code

n402.name: state_or_province_code
n402.conditional: Required when the address is in the United States of America, including its territories, or Canada. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n403.name: postal_zone_or_zip_code
n403.conditional: Required when the address is in the US/territories or Canada, or when a postal code exists for the country in N404. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n404.name: country_code
n404.conditional: Required when the address is outside the United States of America. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n407.name: country_subdivision_code
n407.conditional: Required when the address is not in the US/territories or Canada, and the country in N404 has administrative subdivisions. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

REF.name: Other Subscriber Secondary Identification
REF.conditional: Required when an additional identification number to NM109 is necessary. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

REF.name: Other Payer Secondary Identifier
REF.conditional: Required prior to National Plan ID when an additional identifier to NM109 is necessary. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

REF_G1.name: Other Payer Prior Authorization Number
REF_G1.conditional: Required when this payer assigned a prior authorization number. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

REF_9F.name: Other Payer Referral Number

ref02.name: reference_identification
ref02.description: Y is the only valid value

REF_T4.conditional: Required in payer-to-payer COB when destination payer is secondary to this payer and this payer re-adjudicated the claim. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

REF_F8.name: Other Payer Claim Control Number
REF_F8.conditional: Required when it is necessary to identify this other payer’s claim control number, or when that number is available. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
